test.subject: Test mail
test.intro: This is a test mail from NPMpro at {instance}.
test.works: If you got it, mail works.
reset-link.subject: Reset your NPMpro password
reset-link.intro: Someone asked to reset the password of your NPMpro account at {instance}.
reset-link.expires: Use the button below to choose a new password. The link works once and expires in 30 minutes.
reset-link.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this mail: your password stays as it is.
invite.subject: You are invited to NPMpro
invite.intro: You were invited to NPMpro at {instance}. Choose a password to set up your account.
invite.expires: Use the button below to choose your password. The link works once and expires in {hours} hours.
invite.ignore: If you did not expect this invitation, ignore this mail: no account is active until a password is chosen.
button.fallback: If the button does not work, open this link:
password-reset.subject: Your NPMpro password was reset
password-reset.done: The password of your account at {instance} was reset on {time} (UTC) from the address {ip}.
password-reset.sessions: Every session was signed out. Two-factor sign-in is unchanged.
password-reset.tokens.one: {count} API token stays active; revoke it under Settings, API access if you did not do this.
password-reset.tokens.other: {count} API tokens stay active; revoke them under Settings, API access if you did not do this.
alerts.sample.subject: Sample: {subject}
alerts.sample.note: This is a sample alert mail. Nothing is wrong: it only shows what an alert looks like.
alerts.footer.admin: You get this mail because you are an administrator of NPMpro at {instance}.
alerts.footer.listed: You get this mail because this address is listed for alerts of NPMpro at {instance}.
alerts.host.config_error: The nginx configuration of {name} has an error
alerts.host.config_error.resolved: The nginx configuration of {name} is valid again
alerts.geoip.failed.resolved: The GeoIP database update works again
alerts.ddns.record_failed: Dynamic DNS record {name} failed to update
alerts.ddns.record_failed.unnamed: A dynamic DNS record failed to update
alerts.ddns.record_failed.resolved.unnam: A dynamic DNS record updates again
alerts.ddns.record_stopped.unnamed: A dynamic DNS record was stopped
alerts.ddns.record_stopped.resolved.unna: A dynamic DNS record runs again
account.unexpected: If you did not expect this, contact an administrator of NPMpro.
password-changed.subject: Your NPMpro password was changed
password-changed.done: The password of your account at {instance} was changed on {time} (UTC).
password-changed.done.admin: The password of your account at {instance} was changed by an administrator on {time} (UTC).
password-changed.sessions: All earlier sessions were signed out.
address-changed.subject.old: The email address of your NPMpro account was changed
address-changed.subject.new: This address is now used for your NPMpro account
address-changed.old: The email address of your account at {instance} was changed on {time} (UTC). This address is no longer used for the account.
address-changed.new: This address is now used for your account at {instance} (changed on {time} (UTC)).
mfa-off.subject: Two-factor sign-in was turned off for your NPMpro account
mfa-off.done: Two-factor sign-in for your account at {instance} was turned off on {time} (UTC).
mfa-off.done.admin: Two-factor sign-in for your account at {instance} was turned off by an administrator on {time} (UTC).
backup-codes.subject: New backup codes were made for your NPMpro account
backup-codes.done: New backup codes were made for your account at {instance} on {time} (UTC).
backup-codes.done.admin: New backup codes were made for your account at {instance} by an administrator on {time} (UTC).
backup-codes.old: The earlier backup codes no longer work.
